description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling target player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
